fields.System.Title: OUT-303 — Release a wave and generate pick tasks
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a supervisor, I want releasing a wave to produce sequenced pick tasks, so that
pickers can start immediately with an efficient route.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a planned wave, when I release it, then pick tasks are generated for every
  • allocated line, grouped by zone and sequenced by location.
  • - Given release, then the wave status becomes released and it can no longer be edited.
  • - Given release, then outbound.wave_released is published.
  • - Given the transaction fails partway, then no pick tasks exist and the wave stays
  • planned.
  • - Given a released wave, then its orders show as in-picking.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound |
| Tables | wave, pick_task, pick_task_line, outbox |
| Risks | Partial commit leaving a half-released wave ([doc 09 §2.1](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · rollback · event assertion |
